rv.q: This will never be one of my favourite Sondheim shows but Fiasco make a spirited case for it.

To hear ''No Alone,'' the cathartic and beautiful final song of ''Into the Woods,'' is to be overwhelmed once more by the continuity of one of the American theater's most extraordinary songwriting careers.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Musical

aw.sub: Won Best Actress in a Musical + 2 more

cn.t: Critics find this pared-down production a delightful surprise, with Fiasco's inventive approach emphasizing performance and story while honoring Sondheim's existential fairy-tale journey.

vs.sum: The Al Hirschfeld Theatre offers generally good sightlines, though some seats have minor obstructions. The sound quality is above average, enhancing the theatrical experience. However, the seating is cramped, especially for taller patrons, which detracts from comfort. The theater's ambiance is rich with historical character, though restroom lines can be long during intermission.

acc.note: Orchestra-only wheelchair access. Infrared headsets and audio induction neck loops available.
